# MicroSaaS Solution Finder

> An AI research tool that turns any business niche into its most common operational pain points, three narrow micro-SaaS app concepts that solve them, a three-tier pricing structure, and a feature breakdown scoped to a 72-hour first release.

Site: https://idea-spark-fast.lovable.app

## What it does

You enter a niche (for example "independent dental clinics", "mobile dog groomers", "food truck operators") plus an optional audience size and budget level. The tool returns a structured report containing:

- **Pain points** — 5 to 7 specific operational pains, ranked by severity, each with the signal it shows up in and why it hurts.
- **App concepts** — three narrow product ideas, each with a name, one-liner, target user, the pain points it removes, build complexity, and a 72-hour feasibility flag.
- **Pricing tiers** — a three-tier structure for the top concept with realistic monthly prices and the limits that separate the tiers.
- **Feature breakdown** — features mapped to tiers with hour estimates, split into first release versus later.
- **Markdown export** — the whole report copyable as markdown.

Signed-in users keep a saved history of every report they generate.

## Pages

- [Home / generator](https://idea-spark-fast.lovable.app/): Enter a niche and generate a report.
- [Pricing](https://idea-spark-fast.lovable.app/pricing): Free, Pro and Studio plans.

## Plans

- **Free** — 5 reports per month.
- **Pro** — $19/month or $190/year, 50 reports per month.
- **Studio** — $49/month or $490/year, unlimited reports.

Plan changes apply at the next renewal. Cancellations keep access until the end of the paid period.

## Who it is for

Indie hackers, solo founders, agencies and product teams looking for validated, buildable micro-SaaS opportunities inside a specific vertical, with scope small enough to ship a first release in three days.
